Frequently Asked Questions

Where can I buy peptides in Australia?

PurposeLabs ships Australia-wide from our local warehouse. Orders over $200 qualify for free express shipping, and most orders arrive within 1-3 business days.

Are your peptides tested for purity?

Yes. All our peptides undergo third-party laboratory testing. Certificates of analysis are available upon request.

How should peptides be stored?

Store peptides in a cool, dry place. Reconstituted peptides should be refrigerated and used within the timeframe specified for each product.
